Dennis Rodman

Dennis Keith Rodman

(The Worm, Dennis the Menace, Country, Psycho, Rodzilla, Demolition Man, El Loco)

Position: Power Forward and Small Forward ▪ Shoots: Right

6-7, 210lb (201cm, 95kg)

Born: May 13, 1961 in Trenton, New Jersey us

Relatives: Son DJ Rodman

Colleges: North Central Texas College, Southeastern Oklahoma State University

High School: South Oak Cliff in Dallas, Texas

Draft: Detroit Pistons, 2nd round (3rd pick, 27th overall), 1986 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: October 31, 1986

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2011 (Full List)

Career Length: 14 years

  • 7x TRB Champ

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Dennis Rodman?

Dennis Rodman is 65 years old.

Where was Dennis Rodman born?

Dennis Rodman was born in Trenton, New Jersey.

When was Dennis Rodman born?

Dennis Rodman was born on May 13, 1961.

How tall is Dennis Rodman?

Dennis Rodman is 6-7 (201 cm) tall.

How much did Dennis Rodman weigh when playing?

Dennis Rodman weighed 210 lbs (95 kg) when playing.

Is Dennis Rodman in the Hall of Fame?

Dennis Rodman was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2011 (Full List) .

When was Dennis Rodman drafted?

Dennis Rodman was drafted by Detroit Pistons, 2nd round (3rd pick, 27th overall), 1986 NBA Draft.

What position did Dennis Rodman play?

Power Forward and Small Forward.

When did Dennis Rodman retire?

Dennis Rodman last played in 2000.

What is Dennis Rodman's net worth?

Dennis Rodman made at least $26,965,000 playing professional basketball.

How much did Dennis Rodman make?

Dennis Rodman made $9,000,000 in 1997.

What did Dennis Rodman average?

Dennis Rodman averaged 7.3 points, 13.1 rebounds, and 1.8 assists per game.

How many rings does Dennis Rodman have?

Dennis Rodman won 5 championships.

What schools did Dennis Rodman attend?

Dennis Rodman attended South Oak Cliff in Dallas, Texas, North Central Texas College and Southeastern Oklahoma State University.

What are Dennis Rodman's nicknames?

The Worm, Dennis the Menace, Country, Psycho, Rodzilla, Demolition Man, El Loco are nicknames for Dennis Rodman.
